description:
Company Overview

If you are passionate about water and technology, Trinnex is the place for you! Trinnex is a visionary company that is transforming the way water resources are managed and protected. By combining cutting-edge digital technologies, such as sensor/IoT data, models, geospatial data, and AI/machine learning, we create innovative, smart, and scalable solutions that make a difference. Whether it's optimizing water supply and demand, detecting leaks and anomalies, or enhancing water quality and resilience, Trinnex delivers value and impact to public sector clients across the country.

Job Description

This is a hybrid position requiring onsite presence at our Fairfax, VA office two days per week.
 

Are you passionate about artificial intelligence and machine learning? We're seeking a driven and curious individual to support the development and enhancement of AI/ML solutions that power innovation across our products and services. In this role, you'll help convert algorithms into functional code, interpret complex data sets, and customize predictive models to meet real-world needs.

We value a strong sense of ownership—you’ll be expected to see product and project deliverables through to completion. If you thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment and are ready to take initiative with light supervision, this is a great opportunity to grow your skills and make a meaningful impact.

Contribute to the development of AI/ML-powered applications and systems that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and support smarter business decisions through advanced analytics and modeling techniques.
Assist in designing and developing systems for deploying data-driven and physics-based models, including operations research, statistical analysis, and machine learning algorithms, to support Trinnex’s digital products and solutions.
Support the creation of technical specifications, assess data availability and quality, and apply appropriate modeling approaches to meet project goals.
Write clear and maintainable code documentation using Markdown or similar formats to support ongoing development and deployment of data science software.
Participate in testing and validating AI models to ensure accuracy, reliability, and alignment with business requirements.
Create comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, functional/technical details, and data normalization processes to support data architecture and modeling efforts.
Collaborate across teams and engage with external institutions to stay informed on emerging technologies and best practices in AI/ML.
Assist internal stakeholders and customers with data-related technical issues and contribute to the support and evolution of data infrastructure.
Ensure adherence to best practices in data science, including model training, validation, testing, and algorithm selection.
Perform other duties as assigned to support team and organizational goals.

#LI-DNI

Skills & Abilities

•    Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with team members, users, and external stakeholders.
•    Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
•    Ability to clearly discuss and explain design concepts, trade-offs, and implementation options.
•    Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C, or C++, with a solid understanding of the software development life cycle.
•    Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries and tools (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras).
•    Foundational knowledge of statistical analysis and software development principles.
•    Comfortable working in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.
•    Familiarity with MLOps practices and a general understanding of their role in model lifecycle management.
•    Willingness to learn and grow within the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem, including model deployment and containerization techniques.
•    Openness to exploring cutting-edge AI tools such as Google’s Agentic AI toolkit, including ADK and A2A, to help transform next-generation AI products.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree.
0 years of experience.

Equivalent additional directly related experience will be considered in lieu of a college degree. Domestic and/or international travel may be required. The frequency of travel is contingent on specific duties, responsibilities, and the essential functions of the position, which may vary depending on workload and project demands.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree or higher in Civil, Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, Data Science or equivalent preferred.

Amount of Travel Required

No Travel is required

EEO Statement

We attract the best people in the industry, supporting their efforts to learn and grow. We strive to create a challenging and progressive work environment. We provide career opportunities that span a variety of disciplines and geographic locations, with projects that our employees plan, design, build and operate as diverse as the needs of our clients. CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, pregnancy related conditions, childbirth and related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression), national origin, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Background Check and Drug Testing Information

CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries (hereafter collectively referred to as “CDM Smith”) reserves the right to require background checks including criminal, employment, education, licensure, etc. as well as credit and motor vehicle when applicable for certain positions. In addition, CDM Smith may conduct drug testing for designated positions. Background checks are conducted after an offer of employment has been made in the United States. The timing of when background checks will be conducted on candidates for positions outside the United States will vary based on country statutory law but in no case, will the background check precede an interview. CDM Smith will conduct interviews of qualified individuals prior to requesting a criminal background check, and no job application submitted prior to such interview shall inquire into an applicant's criminal history. If this position is subject to a background check for any convictions related to its responsibilities and requirements, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation including criminal history. Criminal history will not automatically disqualify a candidate. In addition, during employment individuals may be required by CDM Smith or a CDM Smith client to successfully complete additional background checks, including motor vehicle record as well as drug testing.

Massachusetts Applicants

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Pay Range Min

USD $43.70

Pay Range Max

USD $72.11

Additional Pay Range Information

CDM Smith is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. This pay range is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels for the geographic location assigned to the position. In addition to geographic location, a candidate’s salary is determined by several other factors including, but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, relevant work experience, skills, required certifications, and education/training.

Additional Compensation

All bonuses at CDM Smith are discretionary and may or may not apply to this position.

Visa Sponsorship Available

No-We will not support sponsorship in the United States, i.e. H-1B or TN Visas for this position

Agency Disclaimer

All vendors must have a signed CDM Smith Placement Agreement from the CDM Smith Talent Acquisition Manager to receive payment for your placement. Verbal or written commitments from any other member of the CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries staff will not be considered binding terms. All unsolicited resumes sent to CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries and any resume submitted to any employee outside of CDM Smith Talent Acquisition Team will be considered property of CDM Smith. CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries will not be held liable to pay a placement fee.
